standard_prerequisites.name: Higher cohomology of zero-dimensional support sheaves vanishes
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 3855-3857: the cokernel F of O_X -> f_*O_Y is supported in finitely many closed points, hence has vanishing higher cohomology.

standard_prerequisites.name: Vanishing of H^2 on Noetherian schemes
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 3859-3861: H^2(X, G) = 0 for the coherent sheaf G on the Noetherian scheme X.

standard_prerequisites.name: Cohomology commutes with affine morphisms
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 3865-3867: H^1(X, f_*O_Y) = H^1(Y, O_Y) because f is finite, hence affine.

core_obligations: The four-term sequence (proof lines 3851-3857): the exact sequence 0 -> G -> O_X -> f_*O_Y -> F -> 0 of coherent sheaves on X; since f is a closed immersion over the dense open U, the cokernel F is supported in finitely many closed points, and hence H^1(X, F) = H^2(X, F) = 0.

Formal surjectivity (lines 3859-3863): H^2(X, G) = 0 by the Noetherian vanishing proposition; from the long exact cohomology sequence with H^1(F) = H^2(F) = H^2(G) = 0 it follows formally that H^1(X, O_X) -> H^1(X, f_*O_Y) is surjective.
Transport to Y (lines 3865-3867): f is finite, hence affine, so H^1(X, f_*O_Y) = H^1(Y, O_Y); combining with the surjectivity gives dim_k H^1(X, O_X) >= dim_k H^1(Y, O_Y).
proof_roadmap: Write the four-term exact sequence and identify the support of the cokernel F.
Kill H^1(F), H^2(F) and H^2(G) to get surjectivity of H^1(O_X) -> H^1(f_*O_Y).
Move H^1 from X to Y through the affine morphism.
